method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Hattie 从床边踉跄后退，腿软跌坐到窗边的椅子上。
facts.anchor: Her legs wobble and give way. She’s expecting the floor but the chair near the window meets her instead.

facts.fact: 她看清 Eeling 的脸朝上埋在袋中，眼睛半睁、嘴巴张开、舌头歪出。
facts.anchor: Eeling’s face is upturned in the bag, eyes half lidded and stuck in a forever stare.

facts.fact: 她闻到威士忌中夹杂的臭味，意识到那是尸体泄漏的排泄物。
facts.anchor: Except what she breathes in is whiskey laced with an underlying stench, and she understands she’s smelling the waste that’s leaked from his body.

facts.fact: 她下楼后意识到自己已在屋里留下指纹——她掀开了盖着 Eeling 的毯子。
facts.anchor: Your fingerprints are in the house now. You pulled back the blanket covering him.

facts.fact: 她到餐桌打开笔记本电脑，看到登录界面，资料被锁。
facts.anchor: She goes to the dining room table and opens the laptop. Her heart falls from what feels like two stories seeing the sign-in screen.

facts.fact: 她把笔记本拿到楼上，按 Eeling 食指的触控 ID 解锁。
facts.anchor: Turning the laptop awkwardly, she guides it down, tilting it slightly so she can see, and presses the touch ID button to the tip of Eeling’s index finger.

facts.fact: 解锁后屏幕上打开着一个 Word 文档，顶端只有两个词。
facts.anchor: On the laptop a Word document is open, just two words at its very top.

facts.fact: 她准备删除关于 Tommy 的文件，却发现在桌上已找不到该文件。
facts.anchor: The file is gone from the desktop.

facts.fact: 她找敲诈信封，在 Eeling 两天都带到她家的工作包侧袋里找到，上写 Crawford 一家名字。
facts.anchor: The blackmail envelope is in the first place she looks—Eeling’s workbag he brought both days he came to her place.

facts.fact: 她把信封揣进口袋离开房子，边走边用毛衣擦门把手清除指纹。
facts.anchor: With the envelope tucked away in her pocket, she leaves the house, rubbing the doorknob briskly with her sweater on the way out.
